Name: Lemon Tree Mod
Author: HazedHorizons
Description:
When the player is past the initial cutscene and can freely move around their farm, the player can walk to the left past the
bus stop to reach Pierre's. From 9:00am and onwards the player can enter Pierre's
and talk to him over the counter by clicking.

By scrolling down through the shop menu, the player has the option to buy a lemon tree sapling starting at 3,000 gold, which
can be obtained through farming, fishing, mining, etc, and selling their goods
through the shipping bin on the farm, or to Pierre.

Once bought the player can return to their farm to start the planting process. To plant the Lemon tree sapling the player
will hold it in their hands and right click on grass or dirt (The dirt does not
need to be tilled). The sapling needs to be planted in a 3x3 grid (Meaning it
has one block of space surrounding it.)

The sapling does not need watering and will grow naturally over 28 in-game days. Once the growing process is complete it
will start to produce one lemon every in-game day. Note that the fully grown
lemon tree will only produce one lemon a day in the summer, unless planted
within the greenhouse or on Ginger Island.

Once fully grown the player can place furniture items/objects/chests within its 3x3 grid without disrupting it.
When the tree is ready to be harvested, up to3 Lemons will appear on its leaves. The player can then right click on the tree’s
trunk to shake it, releasing the lemons from the leaves and dropping onto the
ground, which the player will have to walk over to collect.

The lemons can then be placed in the shipping bin at the players farm or sold to Pierre's to gain 100 gold (The gold will be
gained the next day if sold through the shipping bin).
